method: Manual visual annotation of original frame125, existing registered 5x source contact sheet, and untouched v2 raw. Boxes are plausible surface-location intervals, not statistical confidence intervals. No skeletal points are asserted.
coordinate_system: Image-local pixel coordinates; x right, y down. Point intervals are inclusive continuous intervals. Source original size68x70; v2 raw1254x1254.

manual_points.label: 可见脸部肤色区域中心
manual_points.caution: Source face/neck/garment boundary is ambiguous at 68x70; not a head joint or gaze estimator.

manual_points.label: 脸部下缘/领口上方表面
manual_points.caution: Low-resolution source does not establish exact chin/neck boundary. Cannot establish a precise full-head scaling factor.

manual_points.label: 屏左肩袖/护肩上缘
manual_points.caution: Visible clothing shoulder ridge, not humeral or acromion joint. Armor/work-panel construction differs.

manual_points.label: 屏右肩袖/护肩上缘
manual_points.caution: Visible clothing shoulder ridge, not skeleton; design can move this ridge.

manual_points.label: 屏左肘区袖面转折
manual_points.caution: Broad sleeve-fold region only; actual elbow is hidden. Do not use as a skeletal control point.

manual_points.label: 屏右肘区袖面转折
manual_points.caution: Broad sleeve-fold region only; actual elbow is hidden.

manual_ranges.label: 深色头冠/发体包络
manual_ranges.caution: Top cap/hair surface, not the whole anatomical head. Hairline and dark side material are ambiguous; cannot justify mechanically shrinking the whole head by this ratio.

manual_ranges.label: 长衣最低可见衣摆带
manual_ranges.caution: Original armor apron/underlayer and candidate cloth hem are different materials. Keep source near-shoe coverage, not original armor segmentation.

machine_roi_definitions.source_body_palette_proxy: alpha>0 and RGB != (16,8,8), exactly as source contract; not approved semantic segmentation
machine_roi_definitions.caution: Hand ROIs begin below the sleeve and use seeded connected components to avoid adjacent coat contamination. Shoe ROIs may include upper hem; only their lowest occupied rows are used.
